description:
Freelance Machine Learning Engineer (Python)

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

What We Do

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI. The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Machine Learning expert, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects. Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design original computational STEM problems that simulate real scientific workflows
  • Create problems that require Python programming to solve
  • Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)
  • Develop problems requiring non‑trivial reasoning chains and creative problem‑solving approaches
  • Verify solutions using Python with standard libraries (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn)
  • Document problem statements clearly and provide verified correct answers
How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements
  • You hold a Master's or PhD Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a similar STEM field
  • You have at least 5 years of Machine Learning experience with proven business impact
  • Strong programming skills in Python (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn)
  • Solid understanding of numerical methods and computational algorithms
  • Research or industry experience involving computational problem‑solving
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge
Benefits
  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $21/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

title: Psicólogo - Supervisor ABA
description:
MISSÃO

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

ATIVIDADES

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial de famílias e indivíduos neuro divergentes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.
  • Coordenar, orientar e treinar a equipe de intervenção, os familiares, cuidadores e outras pessoas significativas, a implementar os programas e procedimentos delineados, na presença e na ausência do aprendiz.
  • Realizar comunicação e treinamento, quando necessário, da equipe de coordenação de cuidado.
ESCOLARIDADE / FORMAÇÃO
  • Ensino superior em psicologia, com carteira do conselho ativa.
  • Pós graduação completa em análise do comportamento aplicada ao TEA.
  • Ter obtido título de mestre ou doutor em análise do comportamento ou áreas associadas ao desenvolvimento atípico (diferencial).
  • Certificação em procedimento de gerenciamento de crises agressivas (diferencial).
EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marcaraiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

Liderar a equipe de vendas externas, promovendo estratégias para o aumento do volume de vendas e o fortalecimento da presença comercial. Garantir a execução eficaz de estratégias comerciais e a excelência no atendimento ao cliente. O Supervisor de Vendas deve atuar como um facilitador no desenvolvimento da equipe, impulsionar o crescimento dos resultados e manter um forte alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais.

RESPONSABILIDADES:
  • Liderar equipe de vendas, estabelecendo metas individuais e coletivas, monitorando o desempenho e promovendo ações de meloria contínua.
  • Acompanhar, planejar e direcionar os vendedores em suas rotinas externas.
  • Analisar indicadores de desempenho de vendas, identificar gargalos e propor soluções para aprimorar resultados.

2. Sinergia, Escala e Eficiência Financeira:
  • Catalisar Sinergias: Atuar como o ponto de conexão entre as divisões para identificar frentes comuns, evitando a duplicidade de esforços e otimizando o uso de recursos e iniciativas. Promover e facilitar a troca de melhores práticas entre as diferentes divisões (Beleza Dermatológica, Luxo, Grande Público e Produtos Profissionais), garantindo que o que funciona bem em uma marca seja compartilhado com as demais. description:
Overview

Galp has been part of society for generations, and as energy changes, we adapt too. Here you will have the opportunity to grow, with the resources you need to develop at your own pace, in your own way. Together we can continue to contribute to the communities where we live and work. We can build a more efficient future for ourselves and for future generations. We're counting on your energy ⚡

Bring your curiosity and passion into action. Join Galp today

About your future Team

You\'ll be joining Reservoir Engineering Team, sharing their mission to deliver decision-ready, high-quality reservoir engineering analyses that directly influence asset development, reserves maturation, and production optimization, while acting as a technical reference within the RE team and across upstream disciplines.

How will your day-to-day look like
  • Compressively and independently manage reservoir engineering discipline scopes across multiple assets, with business focus;
  • Own and deliver reservoir engineering studies for assigned assets across the asset life cycle;
  • Build, maintain, and quality-control dynamic reservoir models and associated forecasts;
  • Provide clear, structured, and decision-oriented recommendations to Asset Teams and management;
  • Act as technical authority for reservoir engineering studies within assigned assets;
  • Ensure technical consistency, robustness, and full traceability of assumptions, methodologies, and results;
  • Proactively identify value opportunities (production acceleration, recovery improvement, risk reduction);
  • Support mentoring and technical development of junior reservoir engineers;
  • Support new business opportunities screening, review, and technical assurance;
  • Act as a key integration pivot of critical decision making disciplines and scopes;
  • Lead and/or support R&D initiatives.
What makes you unique
  • Advanced dynamic simulation capability (history matching and forecasting) using Eclipse and Intersect;
  • Proven experience influencing well testing, well completion, development concepts, well phasing, and production strategies;
  • Reservoir engineering studies execution, including integration of well test data into forecasts and simulations;
  • Reserves and Resources classification expertise;
  • Uncertainty framing and scenario-based decision support;
  • Ability to translate complex technical work into clear business implications;
  • Strong cross-disciplinary integration (geology, petrophysics, production, facilities);
  • Structured problem solving and analytical rigour;
  • Proactive, independent and integrative mindset;
Benefits
  • An energy company integrated in the energy sector where you can make a difference;
  • Competitive salary and bonus;
  • Health insurance for you and your family;
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Galp, we have the ambition to be a Human Centered Company, and for that we acknowledge our responsibility to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) by having a genuine mindset, lived on our day-to-day, in all our processes. We believe that everyone should be celebrated and valued for who they are: not only for their potential, but also for their distinctive characteristics.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  2. the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  3. efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC

Your profile

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Venue Technology Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations)
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process)
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
  • Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc.
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre.
YOUR PROFILE Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
Experience
  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects
Skills & Competencies
  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Description

Experience

title: Agente de Saneamento - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres
description:
Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Main responsibilities
  • Realizar escavações com a finalidade de localizar a rede de água para executar reparos e novas ligações;
  • Realizar serviços hidráulicos relacionados a vazamentos de água em adutoras, rede, ramal, registro e cavalete;
  • Realizar instalação e substituição de hidrômetros, assim com a padronização de cavalete e ramal;
  • Executar a extensão de rede e a interligação em rede existente, oferecendo serviço de abastecimento de água;

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

Psicopedagogo(a) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

O que você fará:

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Procuramos manter a transparência: nenhuma atividade é restritiva; a lista pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se apliquem ao cargo.

O que você precisar ter:

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.
DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

OInspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Oversee the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
YOUR PROFILE
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre o Pensi

Presentes no Rio de Janeiro, somos a escola responsável pela missão de formar pessoas que busquem sempre evoluir e que sejam capazes de construir um futuro melhor para si e para os que estão ao seu redor. Unindo excelência à formação socioemocional e cidadã dos alunos, o Pensi está sempre atento às demandas das famílias e do mundo. Em 1998, o Pensi foi fundado por engenheiros do IME e do ITA. Rapidamente, tornou-se conhecido pela sua quantidade de aprovações. Entendendo que isso é a concretização de um trabalho acadêmico que começa nos primeiros anos de vida, a instituição ampliou a atuação para o Ensino Básico, inaugurando a Educação Infantil e o Ensino Fundamental I e II.

Para alcançarmos o nosso objetivo, contamos com um time apaixonado pelo poder transformador da educação e que entende o que é ser escola hoje, se preocupando, em primeiro lugar, com os alunos. Aqui você vai encontrar:

Oferecemos conteúdo de qualidade e ferramentas modernas de ensino desde o início da fase escolar dos alunos. Transformamos o estudo em um hábito.

Ajudamos os alunos a desenvolverem responsabilidades tanto acadêmicas quanto com relação às suas escolhas. Buscamos auxiliá-los na procura por diferentes meios para alcançarem os resultados que desejam, com olhar crítico e com a construção de novos pensamentos e ideias.

Nossas escolas promovem um ambiente colaborativo que estimula e reforça o espírito de coletividade. Encorajamos a troca e o diálogo em nossa comunidade escolar.

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, seu lugar é no Pensi.

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities
  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.
Well/Project Specific Duties
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).
Education
  • Degree in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) – Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.
Experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza novas ideias. Onde resultados são reconhecidos, os desafios são grandes e o aprendizado é ainda maior. Acreditamos em pessoas inquietas, que pensam como donas, que buscam sempre o melhor e têm coragem para inovar em um setor em plena evolução.

Na Light, cada talento que chega carrega o potencial de iluminar o futuro. Venha fazer parte dessa história.

  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights

Experience in articulating strategic issues and negotiating with C-level executives – experience in leading strategy consulting projects

It’s great if you have:
  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in the online travel or e-commerce industry

  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

description:

It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future. For more information, please visit:

About the Team / role

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Regional Operations Manager to join our Brazil expansion team. In this pivotal role, you will act as the bridge between our central strategy and our local execution in Brazil. You will be responsible for translating global merchant growth objectives into localized strategies, empowering our local Business Development teams, and optimizing our end-to-end merchant acquisition and development funnel. Your work will directly impact our market penetration and success in the vibrant Brazilian food delivery ecosystem.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Strategy Translation & Localization Planning
  • Decode central supply and growth strategies, adapting them into clear, prioritized regional action plans considering local market dynamics, competition, and merchant segments.
  • Proactively identify and analyze high-potential growth opportunities (e.g., emerging zones, trending cuisines, competitor gaps) to create a regional merchant acquisition roadmap.
  • Collaborate in designing and implementing localized incentive schemes to align BD efforts with strategic priorities.
  • Sales Enablement & Process Optimization
  • Design, document, and optimize standardized operational procedures (SOPs) for different merchant types (new, chain, complex) across the entire onboarding journey.
  • Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, and playbooks to address common challenges, strategic shifts, and skill development for the BD team.
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive "BD Toolkit" including negotiation guides, contract templates, competitive intel briefs, and standardized playbooks to drive efficiency.
  • Merchant Opportunity Management & Data-Driven Execution
  • Own and manage the regional merchant pipeline, including sourcing, qualification, segmentation, and dynamic maintenance to ensure quality and volume.
  • Monitor the merchant acquisition funnel metrics, identify bottlenecks or anomalies, and initiate targeted interventions or projects to improve conversion rates.
  • Establish a market intelligence system to track competitive activities, merchant trends, and industry shifts, providing actionable insights for strategy adaptation.
  • Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Lead strategic cross-functional projects aimed at improving merchant acquisition efficiency, solving complex operational challenges, and driving product-side improvements.
  • Act as the key liaison between the regional field team and central functions (Product, Strategy, Marketing, etc.), effectively channeling frontline needs and securing resources.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or above in Marketing, Business Analytics, Statistics, Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in operations, sales operations, or strategy within O2O, e-commerce, SaaS, or a complex sales organization. Experience in food delivery or local services, especially in a regional or HQ role, is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on experience in data analysis: Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, complex functions, charts) is required. Working knowledge of SQL for data querying is a must-have.
  • Proven ability in process optimization, SOP documentation, and end-to-end project management with a track record of driving initiatives to completion.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse, multicultural teams.
  • Self-driven, result-oriented, and resilient, with a strong sense of ownership and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Full professional proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion. Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

As listed under Qualifications above.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets
What You Will Need: Education and Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President

E faremos muito mais!

Se você é Técnica de Coleta e quer embarcar nesse voo com a gente, temos uma vaga te esperando!

Deixa a gente te contar as vantagens de ser Beeper!

Muito bom, né? Mas é claro que não para por aí!

Desde que foi criada, a nossa área de Lab não para de crescer e ocupa um lugar de extrema relevância para a Beep. E o nosso NPS só confirma isso: tá sempre acima de 90! A responsa do time é alta, mas a jornada é gratificante.

Gostou? Então, vem pra #OndaVerde! Vem pra maior do Brasil!

Para ser do time, precisa gostar de trabalhar em equipe, ter brilho nos olhos, ser apaixonado por pessoas e ser aquele parceiro de trabalho que gostaria de ter.

description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

RESPONSABILIDADES O que você fará:
  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS O que você precisar ter:
  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
Será um diferencial se você tiver
  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.
DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Process Eng. -Utilities & Tank Farm - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization.

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.

Key Responsibilities

As successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs.
  • Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification.
  • Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering.
  • Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring.
  • Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno-economic evaluations.
  • Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment.
  • You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling refinery’s utilities.
  • You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation
  • You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have in-depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities.
  • You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems.
  • You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics.
  • You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management.
Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.
